mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, role, content, standalone_query AS standaloneQuery, sources_json AS sourcesJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, role, content, standalone_query AS standaloneQuery, sources_json AS sourcesJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT id, session_id, role, content, standalone_query, sources_json, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, role, content, standalone_query AS standaloneQuery, sources_json AS sourcesJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (session_id, role, content, standalone_query, sources_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{standaloneQuery}, #{sourcesJson})
